paragraphs: Abba Bira'ah, son of Rabbi Elazar ben Yaakov, says; Menachot 93b. Perhaps it should read “in Rabbi Elazar ben Yaakov’s name” (see there), or “of the school of” (see letter dalet, Bedebei).
